about_the_game:
Welcome to Drevolesye — a village where every building breathes through the cracks, every villager sighs deeply, and hope is already packing its bags. It’s here, thanks to fate (and one overly enthusiastic landlord), that you — an accidental hero and reluctant builder — find yourself, perhaps as the last hope for salvation.

What awaits you:

  • Rebuilding a ruined village: build, repair, and upgrade to bring Drevolesye back to life.

  • Helping the locals: from a grumpy blacksmith to a fisherman-philosopher — everyone has problems, and they're more than happy to share them with you.

  • Fishing, logging, gathering resources: if you thought it would be easy — we regret to inform you otherwise!

  • Atmospheric quests: story-driven and random missions that uncover the village’s secrets.

  • Choice-driven ending: decide whether to be a peaceful savior... or a hero who takes up the sword.

In Drevolesye, every day is full of work, strange requests, and small wonders. Prepare to get your hands dirty, catch the most stubborn fish around, and maybe — just maybe — bring the village back to its former glory.
Or at least get the tavern serving something edible again.

  • Memory: 6 GB RAM

short_description: Find yourself in a crumbling village where everyone has either lost something, broken something, or is just waiting for a better hero. Build, help out, catch fish, and try not to stumble into even bigger trouble.
